title: Q01-03 — QC hardening: has_real_clip + has_audio gates (qc-agent.ts)
rationale: QUALITY-01 Rev.3 Sprint 3/4. Add two ffprobe-based QC gate checks to scripts/scs001/qc-agent.ts. has_real_clip: file exists, size>100KB, video duration>1s, video stream present. has_audio: audio stream present (codec_type=audio), audio duration>0.5s. If either fails: QC FAIL, do NOT proceed to publishing, log to logs/qc-failures/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.
success_criteria: has_real_clip gate: file exists, >100KB, video stream, duration>1s
has_audio gate: audio stream present, duration>0.5s

tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/qc-agent.ts with ffprobe-based checkHasRealClip() and checkHasAudio(), QC failure logger
